messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: Mid-career people in Singapore who recently switched or are trying to switch field and had at least one job interview in the last 6 months. One moving from an office field to a different office field, one moving from a non-office job into an office job.
Kind of persona: career_switcher (a mid-career person changing field)
Number of personas: 2
Variation axes (spread the set across these): previous field, years of experience, trust in AI tools, how much they prepare
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): a research interview about how they prepared for their latest job interview

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "career_switcher",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content: {"personas":[{"persona_id":"office-to-office","kind":"career_switcher","label":"Mid-career admin moving to data analytics","first_name":"Rohit","background":"Rohit, 38, Singapore citizen, spent 12 years in corporate administrative support, handling scheduling and document control for a multinational. He recently completed a short data analytics bootcamp to pivot into a business intelligence role.","situation_now":"Actively applying to analyst positions; had an interview for a junior BI analyst role two weeks ago.","goals":["Land a data‑analytics role","Leverage existing domain knowledge in finance","Earn a salary comparable to current","Build confidence with data tools"],"constraints":["Limited time for upskilling (family commitments)","Budget for courses already spent","Self‑doubt about technical depth","Relatively low Python fluency"],"digital_comfort":"medium","reading_style":"Skims headings, then reads bullet points; relies on visual summaries","attitude_to_ai":"Skeptical but curious; uses AI for quick résumé tweaks","known_gaps":["Advanced SQL queries","Statistical modelling concepts","How to articulate transferable skills in interviews"],"biases_or_habits":["Prefers structured checklists","Tends to over‑prepare on company background and under‑prepare on technical questions"],"voice":"Polite and methodical, often saying \"let me double‑check that\"","simulation_notes":"May pause to verify AI‑generated suggestions; could abandon if interview prep feels too technical"},{"persona_id":"nonoffice-to-office","kind":"career_switcher","label":"Former retail manager transitioning to corporate HR","first_name":"Jia","background":"Jia, 42, holds an Employment Pass, spent 15 years managing a chain of retail stores, overseeing staff scheduling, training, and customer service standards. She is now pursuing an HR officer role in a tech firm after a part‑time HR certification.","situation_now":"Has completed three interviews for HR associate positions in the past six months, most recent two weeks ago.","goals":["Secure a stable office‑based HR job","Translate frontline leadership experience into HR credibility","Increase earnings to support children’s education"],"constraints":["Low confidence with HRIS software","Limited network in corporate HR circles","Time constraints due to current part‑time retail gig","Unfamiliarity with corporate interview etiquette"],"digital_comfort":"low","reading_style":"Reads every word of a document; gets impatient with long PDFs without clear headings","attitude_to_ai":"Cautious; uses AI only for grammar checks, distrusts deeper advice","known_gaps":["Understanding of employment law nuances","How to showcase people‑management metrics","Effective STAR storytelling for HR scenarios"],"biases_or_habits":["Relies heavily on past success stories from retail; tends to downplay lack of corporate exposure"],"voice":"Direct and practical, often saying \"I’ve done that before, just on a different scale\"","simulation_notes":"Will likely skip AI‑generated interview coaching after a short glance; may need prompting to discuss soft‑skill translation."}]}
